summary.text: Christine (Cristina) Fontanelli, a Republican and Save NYC Party opera singer, actress and television host, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 75 to incumbent Tony Simone.
She describes herself as a lifelong New Yorker and an award-winning performer, and is the founder of a nonprofit supporting young performers.

paragraphs.text: Fontanelli's campaign website describes a decades-long international career in which she has performed with major orchestras and at venues including Carnegie Hall and Lincoln Center.
She founded the Cristina Fontanelli Foundation, a nonprofit that, according to the website, supports young performers and expands access to the arts.
The site also says her great-grandfather, Rocco Maria Marasco, was a past Assemblyman, and Ballotpedia lists her as the Republican and Save NYC Party candidate.
During the campaign, her website listed public safety, education, housing, cost of living, health care, and arts and culture as her issues.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Fontanelli lost to Tony Simone, according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia.
